extension.summary: Unified content hub for free/legal video, metadata and installed Kodi add-ons
extension.description: MEOS Hub is a single Kodi add-on that brings together free legal content sources, metadata scrapers (e.g. TMDB, archive.org) and your existing installed Kodi add-ons (Scrubs V2, The Loop, Ghost, The Crew and any add-on you choose) into one browsable, searchable interface. MEOS Hub never copies or bundles third-party add-on code: it only routes into add-ons that are already installed on your device via standard Kodi plugin navigation.
extension.author: MEOS
extension.disclaimer: MEOS Hub only aggregates and routes to free/legal content and add-ons already installed by the user. Use responsibly and in accordance with your local laws.
